title: calendars-server: enforce -33 privacy uid and copy rules
description:
Found in JMAP-wf92.15. Two draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-33 MUSTs cannot be enforced at any existing handler or backend seam:
1. §5.9: after applying all creates/updates/destroys of one CalendarEvent/set, CalendarEvent objects sharing a uid MUST share privacy; otherwise reject every create/update in the request touching that uid with invalidProperties. Per-item create_object/update_object calls cannot see the request-wide post-state.
2. §5.10: copying from an account that does not belong to the user an event whose privacy is private MUST fail with forbidden. Copy reads the source with the generic caller-scoped get_objects (which returns the stripped private view) and the handler has no notion of account ownership.
Recommendation: add a CalendarsBackend hook (default fail-open per JMAP-bghk), e.g. a per-request validate_privacy(caller, account_id, touched_uids) for (1) and a copy-source check receiving from_account_id plus the source event for (2).
